title: Baseband PLL
text: Phase-domain model of PLL, 1 input, 3 outputs, {Loop filter type} sets Determine how to define loop filter Transfer; {VCO input sensitivity (Hz/V)} sets the measure of change in output frequency of VCO, {Charge pump current (A)} sets the charge pump output, {Min clock divider value} sets the minimum value by which the clock divider can divide input, {Loop bandwidth (Hz)} sets the frequency at which magnitude of open loop transfer function becomes, {Phase margin (degrees)} sets the phase of open loop transfer function at loop bandwidth subtracted, {Numerator}, {Denominator}, {Open loop analysis} plots open loop presimulation analysis, {Close loop analysis} plots closed loop presimulation analysis and {Plot loop dynamic}. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: In
ports.summary: Input signal from baseband VCO scalar

params.name: Loop filter type
params.values: Determine how to define loop filter Transfer function (default) | 2nd order passive | 3rd order passive | 4th order passive

params.name: VCO input sensitivity (Hz/V)
params.values: Measure of change in output frequency of VCO 100e6 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Charge pump current (A)
params.values: Charge pump output current 5e3 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Min clock divider value
params.values: Minimum value by which the clock divider can divide input frequency 100 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Loop bandwidth (Hz)
params.values: Frequency at which magnitude of open loop transfer function becomes 1 50e3 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Phase margin (degrees)
params.values: Phase of open loop transfer function at loop bandwidth subtracted from 180° 45 (default) | positive real scalar

params.name: Numerator
params.values: Numerator of loop filter transfer function [1.9212e-10, 5e-05] (default) | real scalar | real valued vector

params.name: Denominator
params.values: Denominator of loop filter transfer function [2.0157e-15, 3.0576e-09, 0] (default) | real valued vector

params.name: Open loop analysis
params.values: Plot open loop presimulation analysis on (default) | off

params.name: Close loop analysis
params.values: Plot closed loop presimulation analysis on (default) | off

params.name: Plot loop dynamic
params.values: Plot loop dynamics of PLL system button
